schema_version: v0 — migrates into the intention envelope when MAP.md Q6 lands
owner: akiendelllinux_cc_0 (CC) gates writes. Scope constraint ('ideas to steal, not code') is Akien's ruling, 2026-07-26.
intention: Compile a one-time, deduped index of TheIgorsProject's ARTICULATED layer — design docs, decisions, subsystem index, tickets — so that 'has this already been thought through?' is a lookup instead of a re-derivation. Every entry carries a provenance stamp marking it UNPROVEN-PRIOR-SYSTEM, so nothing from the quarry can ever read as settled.
why: Measured on 2026-07-26: in one session we re-derived the memory storage design by conversation for roughly an hour while it sat on disk with design docs, tickets and tests; separately reported 'no inference host' with ollama running four days; and were about to build the bus VERB without knowing UU had already solved it as a declared-capability Channel. Three stumbles, one root: prior art existed OUTSIDE the search scope. That is Law 1's defect in its purest form — the resolver spent re-deriving the settled. The fix is not more scanning (a per-skill scan is a poll, and would have missed all three anyway, since TheIgorsProject is in none of the three roots); the fix is to compile the quarry ONCE and give /challenge's existing 'prior art?' question something to search.
traces_to: Law 1 — every answered question becomes structure; re-deriving a settled answer is a defect. This node is Law 1 applied to the PRIOR system's answers.

Law 8 — nothing enters proven-space without a proof a hollow build couldn't pass. The unproven stamp is what lets the quarry be READ without anything from it ENTERING. Grafting stays one ticket at a time.
Law 3 — every quarry claim is hypothesis-class by construction; the stamp says so on every entry rather than relying on a reader remembering.

MAP.md:539-548 — the pre-build steps (orient, constrain, deconstruct, plan) are the thing Delta Dental and UU both moved OUT of the model into deterministic code. A compiled index is that move; a per-call review is its opposite.

falsifier: Three ideas ALREADY known to be in the quarry must each resolve, through the index, to a quarry DOCUMENT: (1) the declared-capability Channel pattern (uniform interface + declared cost/reliability/one_way); (2) calving's trigger threshold AND its protected-node list; (3) the node record envelope. Any of the three that resolves only to SOURCE CODE, or not at all, is a RED against the articulated-layer-only scope — it means the ideas do not in fact live in the docs. Additionally: any index entry lacking the unproven-prior-system stamp is a red. A hollow build (an empty index, or a file listing without content extraction) fails this.
horizon: Re-checked at the FIRST graft that consumes it — the read pass over TheIgors' memory design. If that pass needs ideas the index did not surface, the scope was wrong and this reopens. The quarry itself is frozen (measured: 6 files touched since 2026-07-01, none of them design; not a git repo), so the index does NOT go stale from the quarry side — only from a scope error on ours.
distinctions_recorded: THE QUARRY ALREADY CARRIES A COMPILED INDEX. theigors/theigors/subsystem_index/ is 14 markdown files, each summarizing a subsystem and pointing into its own source (graph_calving.md is the exemplar: what's live, what's pending, which tickets, primary files, gates, shaping decisions). So this node IMPORTS AND NORMALIZES an existing compiled view first, and only then reaches for design_docs/decisions. Deriving from scratch what they already compiled would be the same defect this node exists to fix.

IDEAS-NOT-CODE INVERTS THE RECORD. Akien's ruling 2026-07-26: the quarry 'is a place for ideas to steal, not code' — because it lacked the proving structure and the insistence on being shown each thing working, which is WHY Cairn was started over. held-librarian.json currently states the opposite as settled: 'the MECHANISM crosses nearly intact ... the DESIGN does not.' A future session reads that and starts porting the embeddings generator. The note is stale at the source and needs correcting there, not only here.

THE QUARRY IS NOT A ROOT AND DOES NOT BECOME ONE. It is a referenced external corpus, outside all three roots (~/TheIgorsProject). The INDEX is knowledge, so it berths in CairnCommons; the COMPILER is code with one address, so it berths in cairn/. The roots table has no slot for 'external referenced corpus' — recorded as a distinction, not a collision, since nothing about the three-roots rule is contradicted by reading something outside them.

READING CODE AS EVIDENCE STAYS LEGITIMATE; GRAFTING IT DOES NOT. The Channel pattern was extracted by reading calibre.py, not from a doc. Reading source to EXTRACT an idea is how the ruling is executed; carrying source across is what the ruling forbids. The index does not index code, but entries may POINT at code the way subsystem_index already does.
assumptions: STATED, UNTESTED — that the duplicate trees are DUPLICATES and not DIVERGENT versions. The tree carries at least four copies of the same files (_consolidated_2026-06-29/, lab/, archive/, TheIgors-cert-walks/W1/); the same calibre_catalog.py appears four times. Dedup must VERIFY sameness (hash) and, where copies differ, record the divergence rather than silently picking one. Picking arbitrarily would import a version nobody chose.
dependencies: Recorded here as prose ONLY because the per-stage Needs shape (Akien's design, 2026-07-26) is not cast yet. Nothing external blocks BUILDME: the quarry is on local disk, frozen, and readable. This node re-files its dependencies into the per-stage shape once that node lands.
provenance: Emerged 2026-07-26 from a session that stumbled three times on already-solved work. Akien proposed a /scopeout skill firing a full review on every skill call; CC argued that shape is a poll (same cost every call, 95% re-derived — the shrinking-footprint aim rejects it) and would have missed all three of the day's stumbles anyway, since the quarry sits outside every searched root. Converged instead on: compile the quarry ONCE, and fire the EXISTING /challenge — whose five questions already include 'prior art?' — at /intent, where the answer can still change what gets built. Akien then constrained the scope to ideas-not-code and set the priority: below sorting dependencies.
filed_edges: THE 537 TICKETS are indexed as POINTERS ONLY (id, title, status, path) — not summarized. Summarizing 537 tickets ahead of evidence is exactly the volume this node exists to avoid. Opens if a graft needs ticket-level detail the pointer layer can't reach.
THE DIVERGENCE CHECK across duplicate trees is filed rather than designed: hash-compare on build, and if copies genuinely differ, that is a finding to record, not a merge to perform.

/CHALLENGE FIRED AT /INTENT is the CONSUMER that makes this index pay, and it is a SEPARATE node (challenge is referenced as optional in two places and scheduled against a clock that does not exist, so it never fires). This index is useful without it — a human can query it — but the loop only closes when something fires the question automatically.
